hardscrabble.name: Hardscrabble
hardscrabble.note: the village and Thayer's Yard: Ox Road, kept from the hill takes, with its low drone now moving with the chords

pieces.name: Ox Road
pieces.about: wooden flute in long notes over a strum of plucked strings and a low drone that moves with the chords

hill.name: Hill and quarry
hill.note: Hobble Hill, the Quarry, the Cellar Holes and the four stops between: Stone Lane and Sheep Walk, taking turns

pieces.name: Stone Lane
pieces.about: wooden flute over plucked strings in open fifths and a round bass, the whistle joining

pieces.name: Sheep Walk
pieces.about: whistle in three over a hammered dulcimer rolling through open fifths

deep-cut.name: The Deep Cut
deep-cut.note: the cold working under the hill: Frost Bridge, its drone a little lower

pieces.name: Frost Bridge
pieces.about: dulcimer in hanging fourths and fifths, in three, over a low drone on A and E

othertowns.name: Other towns
othertowns.note: same family, different key and lead

route.name: Route
route.note: walking tempo, wandering melody, light backing

woods.name: Woods
woods.note: minor, a little slower, sine and held strings

cave.name: Cave
cave.note: slow and sparse, lots of echo, bell and sine, no arpeggio

mountain.name: Cold mountain
mountain.note: slow, open, high but quiet, slow strings, thin bass

indoors.name: Indoors
indoors.note: gentle and small, bell or music box

battle.name: Battle
battle.note: fast and driving, a little brighter

battle-b.name: Battle B
battle-b.note: for the special areas, Sugarbush and the Old Burying Ground: Am F C Gsus4 start to end, plain and always sounding, with melodies written by hand. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

burying-ground.name: Old Burying Ground
burying-ground.note: slightly eerie, minor key, sparse and low, with the motif far off, at a calm tempo that doesn't crawl

fair.name: Fair
fair.note: evening on the Green, lively and warm

road.name: Road
road.note: the Old Post Road, Cooper's Ford and Sawyer's Clearing by day: a travelling tune, a little brisker than home's route, in D, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

long-wall.name: The Long Wall
long-wall.note: open, cooler and sparse, wide rather than eerie, with the motif far off. E minor, two bars to a chord, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

camp.name: Camp
camp.note: Jasper's fire at night: the lantern-man song the Bard knows. Small and quiet, in three, G major, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

toll-goose.name: Toll Goose
toll-goose.note: the Toll Goose's fight: a march that takes itself far too seriously. B-flat major, oom-pah, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

route-b.name: Route B
route-b.note: a second walking tune, to take turns with Route: A major, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

indoors-b.name: Indoors B
indoors-b.note: a second indoor tune, to take turns with Indoors: small, a music box in three, F major, with melodies written by hand over plain chords. A new batch gives each melody other sounds

jingle-joins.name: Joins
jingle-joins.note: a companion joining: Mrs. Applegate first, others later. Three short pieces written by hand; the honk will be a sound effect of its own
